WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(spent) AS total_spent,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        total_spent / NULLIF(total_amount, 0) AS spend_ratio
    FROM event_totals
), ratios_with_average AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        spend_ratio,
        AVG(spend_ratio) OVER () AS overall_average
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT
    event_id,
    spend_ratio,
    spend_ratio / NULLIF(overall_average, 0) AS relative_spend_ratio
FROM ratios_with_average
ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
